messages:
Anya L: Heads up — euc1 cluster started falling back from RDMA -> TCP around 10:15 UTC. NCCL allreduce throughput dropped ~4x and tokenization batch jobs spiked GPU hours and egress cost.

Mike T: which hosts? paste dmesg + ethtool from one affected node please.

Anya L: sample dmesg from gpu-euc1-15:

```
[2065432100.123456] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: mlx5_core: QP 0x7f time_wait expired, state=ERR
[2065432100.123459] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: mlx5_core: XRQ flush error
[2065432100.123460] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: mlx5_core: async event: port 1 link down
```

ethtool -S mlx5p1 | grep err:
```
tx_err: 1248
rx_err: 12
```

And NCCL logs show repeated `transport: rc` errors then `fallback to tcp` in the same job.

Raj P: what OFED/kernel combo are these hosts on? we rolled OFED 5.9 + kernel 6.4 to the region two days ago.

Anya L: hosts gpu-euc1-{12..18}, OFED 5.9.0, kernel 6.4.14, nvidia-driver 535, CUDA 12.1, NCCL 2.17.3.

Leo W: sounds like an mlx5 driver/firmware vs kernel networking path mismatch. Kernel 6.4 and recent mlx5 FW changed GRO/LRO handling and we observed QP keepalive failures in a previous batch. Quick mitigation is disabling offloads (GRO/GSO/TSO) and forcing MTU=1500.

Mike T: rolling restart will evict jobs. any non-disruptive mitigations?

SRE Oncall: can we route heavy-allreduce traffic to another region/stack temporarily? spinning up dedicated capacity in us-east could be faster than many reboots.

Anya L: I tested `sudo ethtool -K mlx5p1 gro off gso off tso off` on a single node — QP timeouts stopped within ~2 minutes and NCCL switched back to RC transport. But this is manual and we still had sporadic packet drops.

InfraBot: :rotating_light: [alert] rdma_qp_flushed euc1 - 8 hosts affected - automated mitigations triggered (rate limit applied).

Raj P: propose plan:
1) Canary rollback OFED 5.9 -> 5.8 on 2 hosts (gpu-euc1-12, gpu-euc1-13).
2) If canary stable for 30m, roll subset with automated maintenance windows and capacity buffer.
3) Collect full mlx5 debug logs, dmesg, and packet counters; open upstream ticket with Mellanox and kernel maintainers.
4) Short-term: disable GSO/GRO via config and mark node pool as degraded, prefer routing jobs to other regions.
5) Longer-term: pin euc1 to kernel-6.3.x until validated.

Leo W: rollback script ready. will run canary at 02:00 UTC tonight. also recommend pinning NCCL to 2.17.1 for now — that's known to be tolerant with driver 535 in our tests.

Mike T: cost note — TCP fallback increased inter-host egress and host-hours; finance saw ~+48% cost delta in last hour for these jobs. Finance pinged. :money_with_wings:

SRE Oncall: opening incident channel #inc-2065432100 for coordination and postmortem. Please post exact host lists and job IDs there.

Anya L: adding job IDs and raw logs to the incident channel now. thanks all. :eyes:
